subject: English
question_text: What is the teaching of patriotism?
guide_solution: The teaching of patriotism is to grow the sense of fellow feeling, fraternity love and sympathy for the countrymen. It teaches a man to give up self-interest and even to sacrifice his life at the altar of the motherland.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 147 — Hazi Mohammad Mohsin Govt. High School, Chittagong

subject: English
question_text: Why is a patriot so respectful?
guide_solution: A patriot deserves utmost respect because he is not self-centered. As he works for the betterment of his country and his countrymen, he deserves honour in return.

subject: English
question_text: How does a traitor sink into oblivion?
guide_solution: A traitor sinks into oblivion as he is not remembered after his death. Despite having wealth, power and knowledge, he is unsung, he is forgotten.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 147 — Hazi Mohammad Mohsin Govt. High School, Chittagong

subject: English
question_text: How does an unpatriotic person die a double death?
guide_solution: An unpatriotic person dies a double death. Firstly, he dies possessing a dead soul and being forgotten. Secondly, he dies physically.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 147 — Hazi Mohammad Mohsin Govt. High School, Chittagong

subject: English
question_text: Read the passage carefully and complete the table below
stimulus: with information from the passage. 1×5=5 Neil Armstrong was the first man to walk on the moon. He was an American astronaut. He was also an aerospace engineer. SSC English Subject Code : Armstrong was born on 5 August, 1930 in Wapakoneta, Ohio, the USA. He earned his flight certificate in 1945 at the age of 15 only. In 1947, at the age of 17, he began to study Aeronautical Engineering in Purdue University, the USA. He received B.Sc. degree in Aeronautical Engineering in 1955 and he did M.Sc. in Aerospace Engineering from the University of South California in 1970. In 1958 he was selected for the U.S. Air Force's Man in space programme. Neil Armstrong, along with his group, launched the mission to the moon with Apollo 11 in July 1969. He was the commander of Apollo 11 and four days later they landed on the moon. They explored the surface and gathered moon rocks for over two hours. The next day they fired off the surface of the moon. Name of Events Year/Date Place Birth of Neil Armstrong 5 August (i) ....... Received B.Sc. degree in 1955 (ii) ....... (iii) ........ in 1970 University of South California. They landed on the moon iv) ........ Started their return journey (v) ........ from the moon. From your reading of the above passage, fill in the blanks with suitable words. Use one word only in each blank. 1×5=5 Neil Armstrong was the first man (a)  landed on the moon in 1969, He was very (b)  in flying in the sky. So he (c)  Aeronautical Engineering. He was (d)  by the USA Air force to make a voyage to the moon. He (e)  returned to the earth after landing on the moon. Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) 21st February is (i) many people going to the Shaheed Minar. (b) Everyone goes (ii) flower at the foot of the Shaheed Minar. (c) Shaheed Minar is (iii) kept half-mast on this day. (d) The National flag is (iv) covered with flowers. (e) We offer (v) Shaheed Minar to observe the day. (vi) make wreath of flowers (vii) declared the International Mother Language Day. Put the following parts of the story in correct order to rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) The king got puzzled for a while. (b) She desired to test the king and brought with her two garlands of flowers one natural and the other artificial. (c) This is how the riddle solved and the queen went away admiring the kings wisdom (d) The qucen of Sheba heard much about Solomon's court and wisdom. (e) Which pondering, he noticed some bees humming outside the window and asked the window to be opened. First Paper  Questions (f) Once there was a Jewish king named Solomon who was famous all over the world for his wealth and wisdom. (g) She placed them before the king and asked to take the natural one. (h) The bees came in and settled on the natural one. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Information transfer (i) Wapakoneta, Ohio, the USA; (ii) Purdue University; (iii) Received MSc. degree; (iv) on 16 July, 1969; (v) 17 July, 1969.
